items.heading: Bacalhau a Bras
details: Key ingredients: salted codfish, potato, onion, egg
Soak and shred salted codfish.
Fry thin matchstick potatoes and onion until golden.
Toss the codfish through the potatoes and onion.
Add beaten eggs and stir gently until just set, keeping it creamy.

items.heading: Caldo Verde
details: Key ingredients: potato, collard greens, chorizo, olive oil
Simmer potato in water until very soft, then puree until smooth.
Slice collard greens into very thin ribbons.
Add the shredded greens to the pureed soup and simmer briefly.
Top with slices of chorizo and a drizzle of olive oil.
